description: Find AI tools whose providers, on their own websites, refer to the GDPR or state EU data hosting. Each result quotes the provider's own sentence, links the source page and gives the date of GateOnAI's automatic check (about monthly). These are provider statements, not an audit, verification or certification by GateOnAI - check the provider's current documents before relying on them.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 24)

query.description: Optional: words to match in the tool name or tagline, e.g. 'transcription' or 'chatbot'

standard.description: Compliance standard: 'gdpr' for tools whose provider pages refer to the GDPR, 'eu_hosted' for tools whose providers state EU hosting

name: get_eu_gdpr_tools

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Get EU and GDPR Tools
